name: Maintenance Schedule

native.query: SELECT a.asset_code, a.name, ms.maintenance_type, ms.scheduled_date, ms.status FROM ast_maintenance_schedules ms JOIN ast_assets a ON a.id = ms.asset_id WHERE ms.scheduled_date BETWEEN NOW() AND NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY ms.scheduled_date

cards.name: Chi Phí Bảo Trì Theo Tháng

native.query: SELECT date_trunc('month', completed_at) as month, SUM(cost) as total_cost FROM ast_maintenance_schedules WHERE status = 'DONE' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
